messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up: new quickstart hitting client-side backpressure when token rotations align with pagination. Getting rapid 429s even though server quota is fine.

marc: Can you share a tiny repro and logs? sounds similar to earlier threads but might be different.

zoe: Repro: run quickstart with concurrency=10 and a script that forces token refresh every 2s while iterating pages. Logs show repeated fetches for same cursor after refresh.

zoe: sample log:
[2026-04-01T11:02:01Z] INFO paginator fetch cursor=7 attempt=1
[2026-04-01T11:02:02Z] WARN auth refresh for acct=team-beta
[2026-04-01T11:02:02Z] ERROR http 401 -> retry
[2026-04-01T11:02:02Z] INFO paginator fetch cursor=7 attempt=2
[2026-04-01T11:02:03Z] ERROR http 429 rate_limit

kai: Node SDK historically didn't dedupe inflight cursor retries when auth triggers a retry, causing duplicate load. py/go had different behaviors.

marc: Proposed immediate fix: enable retry dedupe in sample quickstart and add small jitter to token refresh in local dev. Long term: unify SDK behavior to attach to inflight promise.

zoe: I've opened an issue and a tiny PR to flip dedupe on for quickstart: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/815

ci-bot: Created issue #4250: "quickstart: duplicate paginator requests during token refresh"

kai: Also propose adding a short note in onboarding docs explaining why 429s may appear and recommended flags: ENABLE_RETRY_DEDUPE, REFRESH_JITTER_MS.

marc: Will draft docs blurb and add an integration test for token-rotation+pagination.

zoe: Verified PR branch locally, duplicates reduced and 429 spike gone.

marc: Closing this thread; tracking follow-ups in GH. Thanks! :tada:
